from pathlib import Path
programs=Path('/home/USER/continual-arc-baselines/.workbench/stage1/HPL0-prime-agent-luna6-medium-ws0/frozen/seen/play/users/u032/system/state/workspace/programs')
programs.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
code='''def transform(grid):
    # Full uniform rows and columns are the dividers between cells.
    row_dividers = [r for r, row in enumerate(grid) if len(set(row)) == 1]
    col_dividers = [c for c in range(len(grid[0])) if len({row[c] for row in grid}) == 1]
    row_groups = _groups(len(grid), row_dividers)
    col_groups = _groups(len(grid[0]), col_dividers)
    out = []
    for r0, r1 in row_groups:
        line = []
        for c0, c1 in col_groups:
            counts = {}
            for r in range(r0, r1):
                for c in range(c0, c1):
                    v = grid[r][c]
                    counts[v] = counts.get(v, 0) + 1
            background = max(counts, key=counts.get)
            marks = sum(n for color, n in counts.items() if color != background)
            line.append(1 if marks == 2 else background)
        out.append(line)
    return out

def _groups(size, dividers):
    groups = []
    start = 0
    divider_set = set(dividers)
    for i in range(size):
        if i in divider_set:
            if start < i:
                groups.append((start, i))
            start = i + 1
    if start < size:
        groups.append((start, size))
    return groups
'''
